-- ClickHouse queries for UserActivity analytics
-- These would run against the local_UserActivity table after data ingestion

-- Query Pattern 1: Activity counts per user over a date range
-- This query leverages the ORDER BY (userId, eventTs, action) optimization

    toDate(eventTs) as activity_date
FROM currentDatabase().local_UserActivity

GROUP BY userId, toDate(eventTs)

SELECT
    action,
    sum(durationMs) as total_duration_ms,
    avg(durationMs) as avg_duration_ms,
    count(*) as action_count

GROUP BY userId
ORDER BY total_events DESC;
